items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: like some of my young friends who recorded when they were real young, Shirley and Lee, and I use them as an example because we were around, we were around the same age and so forth.

ctx.x: Okay. So it seems like over the years you've gotten more into the recording, the production side. Tell me about the production side.

That's because, that's because, you know, like some of my young friends who recorded when they were real young, Shirley and Lee, and I use them as an example because we were around, we were around the same age and so forth. Some young musicians never get to record. Some of the older guys have never been recorded. And it's not documented. Although there are documented things here in the Saga archives that many people don't even know about. Sure. But majority of people don't know about a lot of things that were,…
